requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that raw prescription behavior input is transformed into the defined frontend data contract structure.
The system must validate via unit tests that top relevant drugs are correctly ranked and limited according to specification.
The system must validate via unit tests that the relevance indicator is computed correctly for varying input distributions.
The system must validate via unit tests that integrity flags from backend data are correctly mapped to UI states (clean or flagged).
The system must execute component tests confirming that the MessageBubble renders the prescription behavior module when valid data is present.
The system must verify via component tests that all required UI elements (relevance indicator, top drugs, integrity flag, score contribution) are displayed correctly.
The system must validate via component tests that the prescription behavior module does not render when data is absent or null.
The system must execute an end-to-end test confirming that prescription behavior data flows from backend pipeline through API to frontend chat rendering.
The system must validate in end-to-end testing that the rendered prescription behavior matches the backend API response values exactly.
The system must confirm via end-to-end testing that prescription behavior appears within the correct provider evaluation chat response context.
The system must validate that malformed or partially missing prescription behavior data does not break rendering and fails gracefully without UI crash.
The system must validate that unexpected data types in prescription behavior fields are handled safely and do not produce runtime errors.
The system must ensure test coverage includes both high-relevance and low-relevance prescription scenarios.
The system must ensure test coverage includes both clean and flagged integrity scenarios for prescription behavior.
